name: portafolio-chococoin
description: Portafolio de Germán Lugo (chococoin.dev): landing en tres idiomas + versión arcade 3D en /arcade/

scripts.cv:pdf: next build && node scripts/cv-pdf.mjs && next build
scripts.cv:variant: sh -c 'CV_VARIANT=$0 next build && CV_VARIANT=$0 node scripts/cv-pdf.mjs && next build'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && rsync -rtvz --omit-dir-times --delete out/ stellar:public_html/
